````text
# #3065: Patch: `cargo jackioh run-sim` plays whole dungeon runs with the AI in the player's seat and reports how each kind of fight goes
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The dungeon run's numbers, such as enemy health, prices and what a boss pays out, are placeholders. No test or tool has ever played one of its fights to the end: today's checks start each fight and then make up its result. Once this is built, the maintainer runs one command that plays seeded runs from start to finish with the AI in the player's seat. It prints a table: how often each kind of fight is won, how much health it costs, how far a run gets and what it scores. That gives the placeholders something to be tuned against.

## Why

- `spec/15-dungeon-run.md:286` and `docs/dungeon-run.md:236` list tuning the strawmen as open: `RUN_LEVEL_EMBERS` (`crates/run/src/config.rs:73`), `RUN_ENEMY_HEALTH` (:90) and the `RUN_SCORE_*` weights (:186-208).
- `crates/run/src/walk_tests.rs:58-66`: every fight result is made up ("`fight_won` clamps HP, so any won report is accepted"). `check_fight` (:256-260) creates and begins a fight's game but never plays it.
- `crates/ai/src/match_.rs:69-79`: `MatchSetup` has `dealt`, `last_boards` and `glitch_boards` but no deck marks, so `play_match` cannot play a run fight's Radiant and buffed cards. `ReplayInput` already has them (`crates/engine/src/replay.rs:808`).
- No file in `crates/tools/src` names a deck mark, so the fuzz never plays a game with one either.

## Proposal

- `MatchSetup` takes optional `deck_marks`, passed through `play_match` and the fold. Without them, every game is created and folded as today.
- A new `cargo jackioh run-sim --seeds N [--skill …] [--budget …]` in `crates/tools`, which gains `jackioh-run` as a dependency:
  - each fight comes from `run_fight_setup`, and each result goes back through `run_fight_report`;
  - the player's seat is the AI at R747000's skill knob;
  - map, pack, shop and event choices follow a simple seeded policy, like the walk tests'.
- It prints win rate and HP lost by node kind, HP at each boss, rows reached, turns per fight, score and Embers.
- A per-PR test at a tiny budget, a daily `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` sweep, the tools README row, and `scripts/ci-scope.sh`'s map if the new dependency needs it.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/match_.rs` and `crates/ai/tests/ai/match_setup.rs`.
- A new `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`, plus `crates/tools/src/main.rs`, `Cargo.toml` and `README.md`.
- Possibly `scripts/ci-scope.sh`.
- §15.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A marked card in a `MatchSetup` starts Radiant and buffed, and its record folds to its hash. A setup without marks folds every existing record unchanged.
- [ ] A per-PR tools test plays one seed's first fights at a tiny budget. Every fight ends cleanly (no refusal, fallback or search panic) and folds to its hash, and the run file folds to the same end.
- [ ] The daily sweep plays N seeds at full budget and prints the report.
- [ ] `crates/tools/README.md`'s command table lists the command, so the acceptance README check passes.
- [ ] No strawman number changes in this pull request.

## Size and risks

About 6 to 8 files and 500 lines. Label it hard, since it spans crates. AI-against-AI games are slow, so the per-PR test stays tiny and the full sweep runs daily. The AI plays the player's seat better or worse than a person would, so the report is broken down by skill and is a guide, not a target.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-3` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41936592170)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

`cargo jackioh run-sim --seeds N [--from K] [--skill S] [--budget tiny|full]` plays seeded whole dungeon runs on the real catalog's content. Each fight comes from `run_fight_setup`. The player's seat is the AI at R747000's skill, and the enemy is the AI at full skill with the same budget. The result goes back through `run_fight_report`. Map, pack, shop, campfire and event choices follow a small seeded policy. The command prints, per skill:

- win rate, HP lost and turns, by node kind
- HP entering each boss
- rows reached
- score and Embers

To make that possible, `MatchSetup` gains an optional `deck_marks` (R2702000) that `play_match` and `fold_args` pass through. Without marks, every game is created and folded exactly as today. No strawman number in `crates/run/src/config.rs` changes.

## Steps

3. **Same file, `play_match`.** Add `deck_marks: config.setup.deck_marks.clone(),` to the `CreateGameOptions { … }` literal.
4. **`crates/ai/tests/ai/match_setup.rs`.**

   - Add the test in "Tests" below.
   - Do not touch `a_config_without_setup_inputs_writes_and_plays_the_game_it_did_before`. It already pins the JSON keys to `["controllers","decks","seed"]` and `fold_args` to the plain `FoldArgs`, which proves "no marks, nothing changes".
5. **`crates/ai/README.md` and `spec/rulings/R2702000.md`.** Make the two edits from the table.
6. **`crates/tools/Cargo.toml`.** Add the dependency line. It links only into this non-pure crate, so CLAUDE.md rule 4 and the V2 check are unaffected.
7. **`crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`.** Model the header comment on `fused_pairs.rs`: what it does, the commands, the issue number. Use these items, in this order:

   **Imports.**
   - `jackioh_ai::{AI_BUDGET, AI_SKILL_MAX, AI_SKILL_MIN, MatchConfig, MatchHooks, MatchRecord, MatchSetup, SearchBudget, SeatController, play_match}`
   - `jackioh_engine::{PerPlayer, PerPlayerOpt, PlayerId, Rng}`
   - `jackioh_engine::catalog::registered_catalog`
   - `jackioh_engine::state::{CreateGameOptions, SetupKind, validate_setup}`
   - `jackioh_engine::replay::{fold, hash_state}`
   - `jackioh_run::{RunAction, RunContent, RunFightSetup, RunFile, RunNodeKind, RunPhase, RunSetup, RunState, RunUnlocks, run_catalog_content, run_create, run_embers, run_fight_report, run_fight_setup, run_fold, run_max_hp, run_reduce, run_score, run_seed}`
   - `jackioh_run::config::{RUN_STARTER_CARDS, RUN_STARTER_SIZE}`
   - `rayon::prelude::*`

   **Constants (rule 9).**
   - `TINY_BUDGET: SearchBudget = SearchBudget { nodes: 150, lethal_nodes: 40, determinizations: 1, ..AI_BUDGET }`. This is the arena's `TEST_BUDGET`, whose comment says 80 nodes is the least that files clean. Copy that comment's reason.
   - `MAX_STEPS: usize = 2000`
   - `HEAL_BELOW_PERCENT: i32 = 60`
   - `PR_FIGHTS: usize = 3`
   - `DAILY_SEEDS: u32 = 6`
   - `DAILY_SKILLS: [f64; 2] = [AI_SKILL_MAX, 0.5]`
   - `KINDS: [RunNodeKind; 5] = [Fight, Elite, Ghost, MiniBoss, Boss]`

   **`#[derive(clap::Args, Debug)] pub struct Args`.**
   - `--seeds` is required (`u32`).
   - `--from` is `u32`, default 0.
   - `--skill` is `Vec<f64>`, with `value_delimiter = ','` and `value_parser = parse_skill`. `parse_skill` rejects a NaN or a value outside `AI_SKILL_MIN..=AI_SKILL_MAX`; copy the idea from `arena.rs::check_skill`. An empty list means `[AI_SKILL_MAX]`.
   - `--budget` is `value_parser = ["tiny", "full"]`, `default_value = "full"`, a `String`, as in `think.rs`.

   **`fn fight_config(setup: &RunFightSetup, skill: f64, budget: SearchBudget) -> MatchConfig`.**
   - `seed` is `setup.seed.clone()`.
   - `decks` is `(setup.human_deck.clone(), setup.enemy_deck.clone())`.
   - `handicaps` is `Some(PerPlayerOpt { p1: Some(setup.human_handicap), p2: Some(setup.enemy_handicap) })`.
   - `controllers` is `PerPlayer::new(Ai { budget: Some(budget), skill: Some(skill) }, Ai { budget: Some(budget), skill: None })`.
   - `max_actions` is `None`.
   - `setup` is `MatchSetup { deck_marks: Some(PerPlayerOpt { p1: Some(setup.human_marks.clone()), p2: None }), ..MatchSetup::default() }`.

   **`fn play_fight(state: &RunState, content: &RunContent, skill: f64, budget: SearchBudget) -> Result<RunAction, String>`.**
   - Get `run_fight_setup` (a `None` is an `Err`) and `fight_config`.
   - Build a `CreateGameOptions` from the config (seed, decks, handicaps, deck_marks) and call `validate_setup(&options, registered_catalog(), &Default::default(), SetupKind::New)`. `create_game` panics on a refused setup, so this must come first. Return `Err("the engine refuses the setup: …")`.
   - `play_match(&config, &mut MatchHooks::default())`.
   - Return `Err` naming the first of these that holds:
     - `thrown` is non-empty
     - `rejected` is non-empty
     - `fallbacks > 0`
     - `sim_panics > 0`, with `first_sim_panic`'s message
     - `result` is `None` (no result after the actions)
   - `let game = config.fold_args(record.log.clone());`. Run `fold(&game)`. `Err` if it has errors or `hash_state(&folded.state) != record.hash`.
   - Return `run_fight_report(&game, PlayerId::P1)`.

   **`fn choose(state, content, rng) -> Result<RunAction, String>`: the policy.**
   - It builds the phase's candidate actions in preference order, then the phase's refusal-free action. It returns the first one `run_reduce` accepts. The free actions are those of `walk_tests.rs::free_action`.
   - A helper `index(rng, len) -> Option<usize>` returns `None` for `len == 0`; never call `rng.int(0)`.
   - Per phase:
     - **Map:** `Go { col: random of the next row }`. Free action: `Go { col: 0 }`. The next row is `state.row.map_or(0, |r| r + 1)`.
     - **Reward with an artifact:** `TakeArtifact { take: true }`. Free action: `take: false`.
     - **Reward:** `OpenPack { random }`. Free action: `OpenPack { index: 0 }`.
     - **Pack:** `Keep { cards: rng.shuffle(cards).into_iter().take(keep) }`. Free action: `cards[..keep]`.
     - **ExtractCard and ExtractArtifact:** `Extract { index: None }`.
     - **Shop:**
       - `Buy { index }` for each unsold stock index, in shuffled order.
       - Then `MakeRadiant { random }`, then `Buff { random }`.
       - Free action: `Leave`.
       - Each accepted shop action spends currency, so the phase ends; `MAX_STEPS` guards the rest.
     - **Campfire:**
       - If `hp * 100 < run_max_hp * HEAL_BELOW_PERCENT`, `Heal`.
       - Otherwise `MakeRadiant { random }`, then `Buff { random }`.
       - Free action: `Heal`.
     - **Event:** `Choose { random option }`. Free action: the last option with `hp >= 0 && coins >= 0 && tickets >= 0`, as `free_action` does. If there is none, return `Err`.
     - **Shrine:** `Bless { index: random }`. Free action: `Bless { index: None }`.
     - **Fight, Won, Dead:** `unreachable!`; the driver never asks.

   **Run outcome types.**
   - `struct FightRow { kind: RunNodeKind, hp_before: i32, hp_after: i32, won: bool, turns: i32 }`.
   - `struct RunOutcome { seed: String, state: RunState, fights: Vec<FightRow>, boss_hp: Vec<i32>, faults: Vec<String> }`.

   **`fn play_run(n: u32, content: &RunContent, fight: &dyn Fn(&RunState) -> Result<RunAction, String>, max_fights: Option<usize>) -> RunOutcome`.**
   - The setup is:
     - `RunSetup { seed: run_seed(&format!("run-sim-{n}")), starter: RUN_STARTER_CARDS[..RUN_STARTER_SIZE] as Strings, artifacts: vec![], curses: vec![] }`
     - `RunUnlocks::default()`
   - The policy stream is `Rng::new(&format!("run-sim-policy-{n}"), 0)`. It is separate from the run's own cursor and from the match streams, so the log still folds.
   - Loop until `Won` or `Dead`.
   - Stop at `MAX_STEPS` (a fault) or when `max_fights` fights are played.
   - A fight step: record `kind` from `run_node(&state)` and `hp_before`. If it is the first fight of a boss-class kind, push `state.hp` to `boss_hp`. Call `fight(&state)`. An `Err` becomes a fault named `run {seed} row {row}: …` and the run stops.
   - Any other step: `choose`. Then `run_reduce`. An `Err` becomes a fault and the run stops.
   - Record `hp_after` and `won` from the next state: `won` is true unless the phase is `Dead`; `hp_after` is `next.hp`; `turns` comes from the `FightOver` action.
   - HP lost is `hp_before − hp_after`, net of healing. Say so in the table's header.
   - After the loop, with no fault, `run_fold(&RunFile { setup, unlocks, log }, content)` must equal the end state. Otherwise it is a fault.

   **`fn tally(outcomes: &[RunOutcome]) -> Report` and `Report::render(&self, skill: f64, budget_name: &str, from: u32) -> String`.**
   - The table prints:
     - a header line: seeds, budget, skill;
     - one row per kind in `KINDS`: fights, won, win %, mean HP lost, mean turns;
     - `HP entering boss 1/2/3`: mean over the runs that reached it, with n;
     - rows reached: mean and max, of `state.map.len()`, where rows reached is `state.row.map_or(0, |r| r + 1)`;
     - runs won;
     - score: mean and max;
     - Embers: mean and max.
   - Use `run_score(&state, content)` and `run_embers(score)`.
   - A helper prints `-` when n is 0, else `{:.1}`.

   **`fn sweep(seeds, from, skills, budget, content) -> (String, Vec<String>)`.**
   - For each skill, run `(from..from + seeds).into_par_iter().map(|n| play_run(n, content, &|s| play_fight(s, content, skill, budget), None)).collect::<Vec<_>>()`. Collecting keeps seed order, so the output is the same on any thread count.
   - Return the rendered tables and every fault.

   **`pub fn run(args: Args) -> anyhow::Result<()>`.**
   - Call `jackioh_cards::register_all()`.
   - Build the content: `run_catalog_content(registered_catalog(), &[])`.
   - Pick the budget: `AI_BUDGET` for `full`, else `TINY_BUDGET`.
   - Print the sweep's text.
   - `bail!` listing every fault, so the exit status is 1, when there are any. A lost fight is data, never a fault.
8. **`crates/tools/src/main.rs`.**
   - Add `mod run_sim;` after `mod retcon;`.

     RunSim(run_sim::Args),

   - Add `Command::RunSim(args) => run_sim::run(args),` to the match.
9. **`crates/tools/README.md`.**

   - The acceptance test reads each flag and each `tiny|full` value from that first cell.
10. **`crates/run/README.md` and `spec/15-dungeon-run.md`.**
    - In the run README's "Tests" paragraph, add: "`cargo jackioh run-sim` (crates/tools) plays whole runs with the AI in the player's seat."
    - In §15.12 add a line: `cargo jackioh run-sim` plays seeded whole runs with the AI in the player's seat (R747000) and reports each kind of fight's win rate and HP cost; it changes no number.
    - In §15.13, extend the bullet to "tuning the strawmen (measured with `cargo jackioh run-sim`)".
    - Do not add a `[[R…]]` marker or a new ruling.

## Tests

**`crates/ai/tests/ai/match_setup.rs`** (new test):

In it, p1's card of `decks.0[0]` (hand plus library; `random_decks` holds distinct cards, so `def_id` is unique) must be `radiant`, and `cost_mod < 0 || jackioh_engine::tuning::is_tuned(card)`. ## Done when

- [ ] A marked card in a `MatchSetup` starts Radiant and buffed, and its record folds to its hash.
- [ ] A setup without marks serializes and folds as before.
- [ ] The per-PR tools test plays one seed's first fights at a tiny budget, with every fight clean and folded, and the run file folding to the same end.
- [ ] The daily sweep plays N seeds at full budget and prints the report.
- [ ] The tools README row is in and the acceptance test passes.
- [ ] No strawman number changed.
- [ ] `spec check`, rustfmt, clippy, the AI and tools tests and the `golden` check are green.
- [ ] The pull request names every check it ran and any it could not run.

## Risks

- **Fallbacks at the tiny budget.**
  - The arena's comment says 60 nodes falls back and 80 files clean, but run decks and Hard enemies have not been played at 150.
  - If a fight faults on a fallback, raise `TINY_BUDGET`'s nodes. Never loosen the clean check, and never `#[ignore]` the test.
- **A panic outside `play_match`'s `catch_unwind`.**
  - `create_game` panics on a refused setup, hence the `validate_setup` call first.
  - `run_fight_report` validates again and returns an `Err`.
- **Determinism.**
  - No clock, no `time_decision` hook, per-seed streams, and results collected in seed order, so output matches on any thread count.
  - Never draw the policy from the run's own cursor, or the log stops folding.
- **Hidden information (rule 7).** The AI reads `redact`ed state as it does in every `play_match`; the sim adds no read.
- **Purity.** `crates/run` and `crates/ai` gain no I/O. The sim lives in `crates/tools`, which may print and use rayon.
- **Policy dead ends.**
  - A phase's refusal-free action is always the last candidate, `MAX_STEPS` bounds loops, and the stub-fight test walks 10 whole runs.
  - A run that stops with a fault is reported, not hidden.
- **ts export.** `MatchSetup` has no `ts-rs` derive, so `apps/web/src/wire/` should stay unchanged. The harness checks it.

## Open questions
````
